findings.failure_path: The 'Global boilerplate-strip + retitle' guard is not specific to cards. It covers deleting a duplicated line and retitling its section across N docs, and it is the guard that protects a doc whose substance is that line, plus do-not-touch docs. It now lives only in the reference, which the entry tells the agent to read only before generating, modifying, or reviewing an execution or domain card. A batch strip across specs, runbooks, index docs, or a mixed set never triggers the read. The agent can then apply a blanket replace fallback, which destroys a spec or runbook whose substance is the stripped line or mis-titles its section. The obligation-preservation table marks this rule 'rehosted' but does not check that its trigger scope shrank.
findings.smallest_fix: Keep the global boilerplate-strip + retitle bullet in the SKILL.md entry, next to the applicability guard. Alternatively, widen the load condition to also cover any cross-document batch strip or retitle.
